title: Self-portrait by the river
summary: A flat, painted self-portrait layered over one of my own photographs: sunlight sparkling on a river, an old tree trunk, and autumn leaves floating by.
alt: Digital illustration of a smiling woman with long dark brown hair, black glasses and a grey hoodie, drawn in flat colors and placed over a real photo of a sunlit river with sparkling water, a tree trunk and floating autumn leaves.

title: Friends
summary: Three friends squeezed into one happy frame, drawn in simple flat shapes and bold colors against a bright blue sky.
alt: Digital illustration of three smiling friends leaning together against a blue sky: one with round purple glasses on the left, one in the middle with black glasses, curly brown hair and a green T-shirt with arms folded, and one on the right with shoulder-length brown hair and a black jacket.

title: Through the lens
summary: A relief print of an eye seen through a pair of glasses, carved by hand into a block so that hundreds of flowing lines sweep around the eye like a fingerprint.
alt: Black-and-white relief print of an extreme close-up of an eye behind thick dark glasses. Hundreds of fine curved lines sweep around the eye like a fingerprint, a bushy eyebrow sits above, and two bright white streaks show light reflecting off the lens.

title: Windham Parks & Recreation
summary: A logo for the Windham Parks & Recreation department in Windham, Maine: four circles showing biking, canoeing, fishing and ice skating, wrapped in an oval with the tagline “Find It Here.” It was on the department’s website by 2016 and stayed there until 2025, when it was replaced by a new logo.
alt: Oval logo with a lavender border and the words Windham Parks & Recreation in flowing script across the top. Inside are four overlapping circles: a cyclist under a yellow sun beside a daisy, a person paddling a canoe, a person fishing from the canoe among cattails, and an ice skater on snow. Find It Here is written in blue at the bottom.
